title: [Core] direct indexing on self.block_table_np in compute_slot_mapping (#22940)
gain_evidence: Throughput improved 2.07% for opt-125m with input=800 and output=75
wheel_note: first PyPI release after merge (2025-08-19 > 2025-08-15). Its torch pin resolves to 2.7.1+cu126 (no sm_120), so torch_fix swaps in torch 2.7.1+cu128 (same version, Blackwell-capable).
extra_pip_note: vllm 0.10.1 only lower-bounds transformers; pip resolved 5.x which breaks ProcessorMixin. 4.56.2 is the contemporary release (Aug 2025). pandas/datasets: benchmark_dataset.py imports.
swap_note: whole-tree swap fails: the Aug-15 tree registers _C::aqlm_gemm fake impls that the 0.10.1 wheel (post AQLM removal) lacks. files mode overlays only block_table.py (baseline vs merge) on the wheel's own tree.
test_note: Vendored oracle (data/pr_22940/tests): the merge-tree tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_input_batch.py imports LogitsProcessorManager, renamed in the 0.10.1 wheel, so it cannot collect in files-swap mode. Perf-only PR: baseline and PR's solution both expected PASS.

workload.cmd: VLLM_USE_V1=1 python3 benchmarks/benchmark_throughput.py --model facebook/opt-125m --backend vllm --input-len 800 --output-len 75 --num-prompts 30000 --dtype float16 --max-num-seqs 1024 --max-num-batched-tokens 16384
workload.headline: throughput_output_tok_s
workload.note: Author ran --num-prompts 30000 (opt-125m, in 800 / out 75). We run 2000 prompts per repeat so 5 repeats x 4 arms fit in a session; same per-step hot path (compute_slot_mapping runs every step), throughput ratio comparable, absolute tok/s not 1:1 (different GPU, shorter run). Weights come from the HF cache mounted at /root/.cache/huggingface (.weights/hf on the host). Args match the author: vllm 0.10.1 gives >=70 GiB GPUs max_num_seqs=1024/max_num_batched_tokens=16384 by default, we must pass them; 30000 prompts ~16 min/run so repeats=1.

reported.scale_short: author: 30000 prompts on H100-class GPU; ours: 2000 prompts on RTX 5070 Ti
reported.scale_note: Author reported +2.07% end-to-end throughput at 30000 prompts; we run 2000 prompts per repeat on an RTX 5070 Ti. Ratio is the comparable quantity, not absolute tok/s.

experiments_note: reported pct = author's end-to-end throughput gain; dashboard applies it to our measured baseline
